summary: The code compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly, but contains weak selectors and unclear assumptions. Using roles 'grid' and 'gridcell' for products may not be reliable without verification. The product details selectors ('text=name', 'text=price') are placeholders and unlikely to work. Navigation URL check uses a broad regex that may not robustly confirm navigation to the correct product detail page.

issues.description: Selectors use roles 'grid' and 'gridcell' without verification if they are correctly applied in the application. This can lead to flaky tests if roles are not assigned as expected.
issues.recommendation: Confirm the roles are set correctly in the application or use more reliable and explicit selectors.

issues.description: Selectors 'text=name' and 'text=price' are placeholders and likely invalid. They do not appear to reflect actual text selectors or locators.
issues.recommendation: Replace placeholder text selectors with accurate selectors targeting actual product name and price elements.

issues.description: Navigation verification relies on a weak regex (/.*product-detail/) that may not confirm navigation to the intended product detail page.
issues.recommendation: Use stronger, explicit URL checks or validate unique elements on the product detail page to confirm correct navigation.

recommendations: Verify actual roles or attribute selectors used in the DOM for more reliable element targeting.
Replace placeholder locators with actual selectors from the application under test.
Improve navigation assertions by verifying unique page elements or exact URLs after navigation.
